top_3_arguments: Breakout quality is poor: daily_indicators.volume.relative_volume = 0.57 (current 769,100 vs avg_volume_20 1,351,375) and volume_bias_10d = 'down'. Confirming on the hourly: hourly_indicators.rsi_divergence.bearish = true and hourly MACD bullish_crossover = false despite price ticking up — intraday thrust is fading right at the level.

Trend strength does not support a fresh breakout: daily_indicators.adx.adx_14 = 19.24 ('weak') and minus_di (26.57) > plus_di (20.78) — directional bias on the daily is net BEARISH even as price rallies. Daily rsi_14 = 46.02 (below 50, no medium-term momentum) while rsi_7 = 80.64 (extreme short-term stretch). Daily momentum.roc_10d is still negative at -1.61. This is a counter-trend bounce into resistance, not an impulse leg.

R:R math at the stated levels is unworkable. Entry 265.00 with invalidation 261.50 = $3.50 risk, but daily atr_14 = 16.41 — the stop is only 0.21 ATR away, so normal daily noise will stop the trade out before the thesis plays out. A realistic ATR-respecting stop sits at the 250.05 hourly pivot (12 tests, volume_confirmed), making true risk ~$15 vs ~$10 to the 275.25 next resistance — sub-1:1 R:R when the stop reflects real volatility.
